_comment: Tier-2 for kratos.dem pitfall #13 (and the matching auxiliary_overview entry): Kratos DEM is not 3D-only. FALSE CLAIM CORRECTED. The catalog asserted in two places that 'DEM is always 3D internally' and that a planar problem must use SphericParticle3D with constrained out-of-plane DOFs. Executed 2026-08-07 on Kratos 10.4.3 Release with DEMApplication loaded: CreateNewElement('CylinderParticle2D', ...) and CreateNewElement('CylinderContinuumParticle2D', ...) both construct on the same model part where CreateNewElement('SphericParticle2D', ...) raises RuntimeError 'The Element "SphericParticle2D" is not registered!'. So the narrow observation (no SphericParticle2D) was right and the generalisation drawn from it was wrong; the 2D particle simply lives under the Cylinder* stem, with the 2D discontinuum law spelled DEM_D_Hertz_viscous_Coulomb2D. Corroborated by the registration list in DEMApplication's source, which registers CylinderParticle2D and CylinderContinuumParticle2D alongside the 3D spheres. This fixture pins both halves so the corrected claim cannot silently revert. NOTE: the older fixture dem_spheric_particle_2d_rejected still passes and is still true -- it only ever asserted that SphericParticle2D is unregistered -- but its docstring carried the false generalisation, which has been corrected there too. INTERPRETER: needs a Kratos build carrying DEMApplication; set KRATOS_PYTHON. The repo venv wheel does not import on this host (GLIBC_2.32 vs 2.31) and ships only three applications. MUTATION CONTROL (T2_MUTATE=1, re-runnable): the mutation INVERTS the expected verdict for all three element names while leaving the CreateNewElement calls untouched, so it proves the booleans come from real construction against the registry rather than an echoed table. Verified: unmutated PASSES (rc=0) with element_registration_mismatches=0; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1), element_registration_mismatches=3, and all three constructs[...]_expected=... lines flip. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/dem_has_real_2d_cylinder_particles && $KRATOS_PYTHON source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 $KRATOS_PYTHON source.py (fails). HARNESS FIX 2026-08-07: forbid_in_output was ['MISMATCH'], and the runner's matcher is case-insensitive SUBSTRING, so it also matched the '..._mismatches=0' line this fixture prints on SUCCESS. Every passing run was recorded as failed -- the fixture exits 0 and discriminates correctly (T2_MUTATE=1 gives rc=1), but the ledger showed FAIL. Narrowed to 'MISMATCH:' with the colon, which appears only in the real failure line and not in the counter. Nothing about the fixture's code or assertions changed.
